verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is pre-run review: Bento says you can 'check every branch before it runs' for flows, and teams can keep separate production and testing Sites for QA. Nothing documents versioning or rollback for workflows, and template edits propagate everywhere immediately. Missing for 10: workflow version history, diff/review of changes, rollback to a prior version, API/CLI/MCP access to automation versions, independent corroboration.
